title: Chapter 347 Hospitality Lin Family
content:
Chapter 347 Hospitality Lin Family

Mr. Jiang?

When Lu Daosheng heard the movement outside the house, he was slightly stunned and was suddenly surprised.

The old man actually came here.

I also blamed myself for being a little anxious and did not reply to them.

And Mr. Lin Ye and his wife naturally heard the sound of Mr. Jiang coming in outside the house.

The two of them looked a little strange.

Lin Ye coughed lightly and kicked Lin Xu on the side.

Lin Xu was unstable and fell to bite the dog.

"Hey, let me go, grandpa, what are you doing?!"

"You little brat, why don't you go and apologize to you Grandpa Jiang!"

Linye shouted angrily.

Upon hearing this, Lin Xu shrank his body, and naturally did not dare to refuse to agree. He quickly got up and ran outside.

"Mr. Lu, don't worry, from now on, the Jiang family will be my Lin family's best friend, sharing honor and disgrace."

Sharing honor and disgrace?

Lu Daosheng chuckled, "What if I say, let your Lin family become a vassal of the Jiang family?"

This sentence made Lin Ye tremble in his heart. Looking at Lu Daosheng's gentle smile, he felt like he fell into an ice cave at this moment.

Oh my God, why did I have the illusion that there is something easy to talk to in front of me?

Lin Ye was shocked and sweated coldly, lowered his head slightly and said, "If Mr. Lu is willing, my Lin family will be willing to become a vassal."

Facing Lu Daosheng, he still chose to surrender.

From the appearance of Lu Daosheng to the present, he has shown his unique ability to pass through heaven and earth.

This person is definitely not an ordinary person.

It must be an existence that emerged from some force that transcends the secular world.

As the head of a top family in Yunshan City, he naturally has some understanding of this.

That kind of existence, facing ordinary forces like them, is a dimensionality reduction strike, and he has no chance to resist at all.

Although I feel very unwilling to accept it, there is no other way.

Lin Ye sighed in his heart, waiting for Lu Daosheng to judge his Lin family.

However, as time passed by minute by minute, Lu Daosheng was reluctant to speak.

Just when he was confused, Lu Daosheng suddenly walked out of the house.

Lu Daosheng did not answer, and he already had an answer in his heart.

Outside the house.

"Old Master Jiang, calm down."

Facing Mr. Jiang, who was burning with anger all over, Lin Wennuan was a little scared, but she still bravely stepped forward to persuade him.

"Go away, it's nothing to do with you. Let the old guy named Lin get out!"

At this moment, Mr. Jiang was obviously blinded by anger, and the head of the Li family on the side looked embarrassed.

"Old Jiang, don't be impulsive. This is also the territory of the Lin family."

Old Li stepped forward and whispered.

Although his Li family is not afraid of the Lin family, he is still so arrogant on his territory, and he is really looking for a fight.

Following Old Li, there was also a strong man. At this moment, he was staring at Ma Ye in the distance and staring at him.

At this time, Mr. Ma was also looking at him. The two existences representing the peak of the combat power of the two families were facing each other, and sparks flew everywhere for a moment.

"Grandpa Jiang!"

At this moment, a young man in the house stumbled out.

As soon as he got up, under the shocked eyes of everyone, he hugged Mr. Jiang's thighs regardless of his face, and cried while hugging, "Grandpa Jiang, I'm sorry for you!"

At this moment, Mr. Jiang was a little confused.

What's going on?

Jiang Xiaoxiao, who was standing beside her, also stared at the young man in front of her with wide eyes.

After looking for a while, she confirmed the identity of the person in front of her.

"Lin Xu?! It's you!"

Lin Xu!

Mr. Jiang also came to his senses. Isn’t this the boy who harassed his granddaughter?

"Okay, it turns out that it's you boy!"

Mr. Jiang kicked Lin Xu aside with one kick.

I have to say that Mr. Jiang is in good health now. Not only can he not see how sick he was, but he is also much stronger than he used to be.

I just got kicked by my own grandfather, and now I'm kicked again.

Lin Xu today is definitely the most difficult day in his life.

But at this moment he dared not complain.

There was a great god behind him staring at him.

"Grandpa Jiang, please calm down. All the mistakes are my own fault. I am willing to take responsibility for everything."

Lin Xu stepped forward again and said pitifully.

As he said that, Lin Xu looked at Jiang Xiaoxiao next to Mr. Jiang again.

"Xiaoxiao, no, Miss Jiang, what happened before was that I was wrong. From now on, I will never disturb you again. If you don't remember the villain's life, just forgive me."

Lin Xu's huge contrast made Jiang Xiaoxiao a little confused.

What happened to Lin Xu? Why did he suddenly change his temperament?

He looked arrogant before.

"Ahem."

Just as the Jiang family was thinking, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly, slowly walked out of the house, and appeared in everyone's sight.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, the Jiang family looked overjoyed, and did not notice that everyone present in the Lin family bowed their heads slightly and looked respectful.

He even didn't notice that Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, followed behind Lu Daosheng like a servant.

"Brother Sheng! You're fine!!"

"Xiaosen, what are you,"

"I'm fine."

Looking at the worried two people in front, Lu Daosheng felt very warm and responded with a smile.

"The Lin family is still very polite."

"Very, very polite???"

Mr. Jiang couldn't believe his ears.

Although I am old, my ears won’t be able to hear clearly so quickly.

He didn't believe it, and the Lin family could hang the words "polite" on it.

If the Lin family were really polite, their Jiang family would not have fallen so quickly back then.

"Of course, you're very polite. Do you think so, head of the Lin family?"

Lu Daosheng still smiled and looked at Forestry, who was silently standing behind his right.

At this time, Mr. Jiang and Jiang Xiaoxiao noticed that there was still someone standing behind Lu Daosheng.

Lin Ye also looked embarrassed when he heard Lu Daosheng's question.

"Ahem, ah haha, you're welcome, of course you're welcome."

Lin Ye looked at Mr. Jiang, then stepped forward enthusiastically and held his hand.

"Lao Jiang, I haven't seen you for many years, I miss you very much."

This sentence immediately made Old Master Jiang get goose bumps, and then he quickly pulled his hand away and retreated with an unkind look.

After looking at the forestry in front of him for a few glances, Mr. Jiang finally confirmed that the old guy in front of him who looked very kind is indeed forestry, and he immediately took a breath.

Hell.

Um? etc.

"Your legs are ready!"

Mr. Jiang blurted out.

Upon hearing this, Lin Ye laughed, "It's thanks to Mr. Lu."

Mr. Lu.

Mr. Jiang's eyes moved to Lu Daosheng.

In response, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

Since then, Mr. Jiang has understood.

It was not surprising that Lu Daosheng was able to cure forestry's lame legs.

After all, wasn’t Lu Daosheng cured his terminal illness?

Moreover, he didn't even know how to cure it.
